subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Mr. Patel is likely to win the __elections in the sweeping__ majority.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"by"** is used to indicate the means or method through which something is accomplished. (द्वारा)

 
 
• **Example:** She succeeded **by** working hard and staying focused on her goals.
 
 
 
• **"Sweeping majority"** refers to a very large majority. (बहुमत)
 
 
• **Example:** The candidate won the election by a sweeping majority, securing almost 80% of the votes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** "elections on a sweeping majority" (बहुमत पर)

 
 
• **Example:** This option does not fit well in the context of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "elections of a sweeping majority" (बहुमत का)
 
 
• **Example:** This option is grammatically incorrect in the given context.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "elections at a sweeping majority" (बहुमत पर)
 
 
• **Example:** This option does not fit well in the context of the sentence.
